name: translay
description: A lightweight Windows selection translation tool powered by local or OpenAI-compatible models.

scripts.check:frontend: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:core: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/translay-core/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path crates/translay-core/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run check:core && npm run check:rust
scripts.macos:check: npm run macos:build:frontend && cargo fmt --manifest-path experiments/macos-spike/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path experiments/macos-spike/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --locked
